entities.name: Darien's Roost
entities.description: Mountain town in the Karplusan Mountains founded during the peacemaking between Kjeldor and Balduvia, later called Epityr.

entities.name: Kjeldor
entities.description: Nation whose first outpost was Darien's Roost.

entities.name: Balduvia
entities.description: Nation that traded with Kjeldor at the roost.

entities.name: Darien
entities.description: King in whose honor the town was named.

entities.name: New Argive
entities.description: Newly founded nation of which the town became part.

entities.name: Karplusan Mountains
entities.description: Mountains where the town was founded.

events.summary: Darien's Roost was founded as the first Kjeldoran outpost allowed in an ideal trading location for Kjeldor and Balduvia.
events.quote: It was the first Kjeldoran outpost allowed to be constructed

events.summary: Over three hundred years the town grew prosperous and picked up the ancient name Epityr.
